description: Shared definitions and utilities for navigation mesh generation and usage in a game, including configuration structures, enum definitions, class declarations, and functions related to navmesh processing.

classes.name: NavgenConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for navmesh generation, including cell size, step size, and filtering options.

classes.name: NavgenMapIdentification
classes.description: Identifies a map for navmesh purposes, using checksum or size verification.

classes.name: NavMeshSetHeader
classes.description: Header structure for navmesh set files, containing metadata and configuration.

classes.name: NavMeshTileHeader
classes.description: Header for individual navmesh tiles, including reference and data size.

classes.name: FastLZCompressor
classes.description: Implements compression and decompression of navmesh tile data using fastlz.

classes.name: BasicMeshProcess
classes.description: Processes mesh polygons, assigning areas and flags based on tile cache data.

classes.name: LinearAllocator
classes.description: Memory allocator for navmesh tile cache, using linear allocation strategy.

methods.name: GetNavgenMapId
methods.description: Retrieves a map identification object based on map name.

methods.name: ReadNavgenConfig
methods.description: Reads navmesh generation configuration for a given map.

methods.name: GetNavmeshHeader
methods.description: Generates a header for navmesh files based on configuration and map name.

methods.name: ProductVersionHash
methods.description: Computes a hash of the product version string.

methods.name: NavmeshForClass
methods.description: Determines the appropriate navmesh class for a given character class, optionally reducing types.

methods.name: RequiredNavmeshes
methods.description: Returns a list of navmesh classes required for a given configuration.

methods.name: NavmeshFilename
methods.description: Constructs a filename for the navmesh based on map name and character class.
